title: PSTO: A PDE-structured transport operator with shared implicit updates for multiscale CDR systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.25607v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiscale convection-diffusion-reaction (CDR) systems couple spatial transport with local stiff reaction kinetics, making their numerical simulation computationally demanding. Conventional neural surrogates require costly coupled CDR training data, and their parameter counts scale with the number of transported variables, limiting scalability to high-dimensional CDR systems. Here we propose a PDE-Structured Transport Operator (PSTO) that learns convection--diffusion dynamics solely from reaction-free data. By embedding the PDE structure into the neural architecture, PSTO generalizes to full CDR systems at inference without retraining. A single transport operator block is shared across all transported variables and refined through relaxed fixed-point iterations, performing an implicit-like correction in latent space. translated_title: PSTO：用于多尺度对流-扩散-反应系统的具有共享隐式更新的PDE结构化输运算子
translated_abstract: 多尺度对流-扩散-反应（CDR）系统将空间输运与局部刚性反应动力学耦合在一起，使其数值模拟在计算上代价高昂。传统的神经代理模型需要昂贵的耦合CDR训练数据，且其参数量随输运变量数量的增加而增长，限制了其在高维CDR系统上的可扩展性。本文提出了一种PDE结构化输运算子（PSTO），它仅从无反应数据中学习对流-扩散动力学。通过将PDE结构嵌入到神经架构中，PSTO能够在推理阶段泛化到完整的CDR系统而无需重新训练。单个输运算子模块在所有输运变量之间共享，并通过松弛不动点迭代进行精化，在潜空间中执行类隐式的修正。这在不增加可训练参数的情况下提高了递归多步预测的稳定性。我们对PSTO进行了评估……
tldr: PSTO通过将PDE结构嵌入神经架构并在所有输运变量间共享单一输运算子模块、结合松弛不动点迭代实现类隐式修正，仅需无反应数据训练即可在推理时无需重训练地泛化到完整的多尺度对流-扩散-反应系统，且不增加参数量。
en_tdlr: PSTO embeds PDE structure into a neural architecture with a single shared transport operator refined by relaxed fixed-point iterations, enabling generalization to full multiscale CDR systems at inference from reaction-free training data alone—without retraining or extra parameters.
